hero.title: Implantology
hero.description: Implantology is the most advanced method to replace missing teeth. Dental implants provide a permanent solution that looks, functions, and feels like a natural tooth.

section1.title: Modern solution for missing teeth
section1.paragraph1: A dental implant is a titanium screw inserted into the jawbone that acts as an artificial tooth root. A crown is then placed on top to fully replace the natural tooth in function and appearance.
section1.paragraph2: Today, implantology allows missing teeth to be replaced quickly, painlessly, and long-term, with minimal invasiveness and high success rate.
section1.list2: No need to grind adjacent teeth

section2.title: Implant placement and recovery process
section2.paragraph1: Implant placement is a precise and painless procedure performed under local anesthesia. After placement, the implant naturally fuses with the bone over several weeks.
section2.paragraph2: Afterwards, the abutment and crown are placed, resulting in a fully functional and aesthetically perfect tooth. The whole process is supervised by our experts.
section2.paragraph3: Implants do not require special care — regular hygiene and dental check-ups ensure longevity and stability.

cta.title: Restore function and your smile with dental implants

interestingFacts.paragraph1: Many patients postpone visiting the dentist until a problem becomes serious, even though modern dentistry today offers fast, painless, and long-lasting solutions. When it comes to dental fillings, the choice of material plays a crucial role in both function and appearance. In the past, amalgam fillings were widely used due to their durability, but they were highly visible because of their dark color. As a result, many patients felt self-conscious about their smile.
interestingFacts.paragraph2: Today, the situation is completely different.
interestingFacts.paragraph3: Composite (white) fillings allow the tooth to be restored in a way that makes the filling almost invisible. After treatment, patients regain a natural-looking smile without visible signs of dental work.
interestingFacts.paragraph4: For cases requiring even higher precision and durability, ceramic fillings and inlay/onlay restorations are used. These are custom-made in a dental laboratory and represent a premium level of dental restoration — ideal for patients who want maximum aesthetics and long-term stability.
interestingFacts.title: Composite & Ceramic Fillings
interestingFacts.paragraph5: Modern materials and techniques allow well-done restorations to last 10–15 years or even longer with proper oral hygiene and regular dental check-ups.
interestingFacts.paragraph6: The goal of modern dentistry is not just to “fix a tooth”, but to restore natural appearance, function, and confidence in everyday life.

blogImplanti.title: How Much Does a Dental Implant Cost in Belgrade?
blogImplanti.intro: Dental implant placement is one of the most reliable and long-lasting solutions for replacing missing teeth. One of the most common questions patients ask is how much a dental implant costs in Belgrade and what factors influence the final treatment price. In this guide, we explain everything you need to know before making a decision.

sections.heading: What Is a Dental Implant?
sections.content: A dental implant is an artificial tooth root made of biocompatible titanium that is placed into the jawbone. After the healing process, a dental crown is attached to the implant, closely mimicking the appearance and function of a natural tooth.

sections.heading: What Determines the Cost of a Dental Implant?
sections.content: The price depends on the implant manufacturer, material quality, the patient's bone condition, the need for additional procedures, and the type of prosthetic restoration placed on the implant.

sections.heading: What Does the Procedure Look Like?
sections.content: The process begins with an examination and diagnostics. After treatment planning, the implant is placed under local anesthesia. Following the healing period, a permanent crown is attached.

sections.heading: Is Dental Implant Placement Painful?
sections.content: Modern anesthesia techniques make the procedure almost completely painless. After treatment, mild discomfort may occur but usually subsides within a few days.

sections.heading: How Long Does Recovery Take?
sections.content: Most patients return to their daily activities the following day. Complete integration of the implant with the bone takes several months and is crucial for treatment success.

sections.heading: Who Is a Candidate for a Dental Implant?
sections.content: Most adults with good overall health and sufficient bone volume can be candidates for implant therapy. The final assessment is made by a dentist after an examination.

sections.heading: Benefits of Dental Implants
sections.content: Dental implants provide a natural appearance, chewing stability, preservation of jawbone structure, and a long-term solution that can last for decades with proper oral hygiene.

faq.question: How Long Does Dental Implant Placement Take?
faq.answer: The procedure itself usually takes between 30 and 60 minutes, depending on the complexity of the case.

faq.question: Can a Dental Implant Last a Lifetime?
faq.answer: With proper oral hygiene and regular check-ups, a dental implant can last for several decades.

faq.question: Can Everyone Get a Dental Implant?
faq.answer: Most adults are candidates, but an examination is necessary to evaluate bone condition and oral health.

blogImplanti.conclusion: Dental implants are a modern, aesthetically pleasing, and long-lasting solution for replacing missing teeth. If you would like to find out whether you are a candidate for implant therapy, schedule an examination and consultation with our team.

seo.metaDescription: Learn what affects the cost of dental implants, how the procedure is performed, recovery time, and the benefits of implant therapy.

blogKarijes.title: Tooth Decay – How Does It Develop and How Can It Be Prevented?
blogKarijes.intro: Tooth decay is one of the most common dental diseases affecting both children and adults. It develops gradually and, if left untreated, can lead to serious problems such as infections, pain, and tooth loss.

sections.heading: How Does Tooth Decay Develop?
sections.content: Tooth decay develops when bacteria break down food particles and produce acids that damage tooth enamel.

sections.heading: What Are the First Symptoms?
sections.content: Early symptoms may include sensitivity to cold, hot, or sweet foods and drinks, as well as dark spots appearing on the tooth surface.

sections.heading: How Can Tooth Decay Be Prevented?
sections.content: Regular brushing, flossing, fluoride toothpaste, and routine dental check-ups significantly reduce the risk of tooth decay.

sections.heading: How Is Tooth Decay Treated?
sections.content: Treatment depends on the stage of damage. In early stages, removing the decay and placing a filling is usually sufficient.

faq.question: Can Tooth Decay Go Away on Its Own?
faq.answer: No. Tooth decay does not heal on its own and requires dental treatment.

faq.question: How Often Should I Visit the Dentist?
faq.answer: A routine dental examination every six months is recommended.

blogKarijes.conclusion: Early diagnosis and regular check-ups are the best way to preserve the health of your teeth.

seo.metaTitle: Tooth Decay – Symptoms, Causes and Treatment | Dental House
seo.metaDescription: Learn how tooth decay develops, what the early symptoms are, and how to prevent and treat it successfully.

blogOrtodoncija.title: Braces – When Is the Right Time for Orthodontic Treatment?
blogOrtodoncija.intro: Misaligned teeth can affect both the appearance of your smile and the function of your bite. Orthodontic treatment helps straighten teeth and improve oral health.

sections.heading: Why Is Orthodontic Treatment Important?
sections.content: Properly aligned teeth make oral hygiene easier and reduce the risk of tooth decay and gum disease.

sections.heading: When Is the Best Time for Braces?
sections.content: Although treatment often begins during childhood, adults can also successfully undergo orthodontic treatment with braces.

sections.heading: How Long Does Treatment Last?
sections.content: The duration depends on the complexity of the case and typically ranges from 12 to 24 months.

sections.heading: How Should Braces Be Maintained?
sections.content: Regular cleaning and dental check-ups according to your orthodontist’s recommendations are essential.

faq.question: Do Braces Hurt?
faq.answer: Some mild discomfort may occur after placement, but it usually subsides within a few days.

faq.question: Can Adults Wear Braces?
faq.answer: Yes, orthodontic treatment is highly successful in adult patients as well.

blogOrtodoncija.conclusion: A healthy bite and a beautiful smile are investments in both your health and self-confidence.

seo.metaTitle: Braces and Orthodontic Treatment | Dental House
seo.metaDescription: Learn when the right time is for braces and how long orthodontic treatment typically lasts.

blogIzbeljivanje.title: Professional Teeth Whitening – Everything You Need to Know
blogIzbeljivanje.intro: White and bright teeth are among the most requested cosmetic dental treatments. Professional teeth whitening provides noticeable results in a safe and effective way.

sections.heading: What Is Professional Teeth Whitening?
sections.content: A procedure that uses specialized gels and modern techniques to remove stains and discoloration from the tooth surface.

sections.heading: Who Is a Candidate for Treatment?
sections.content: Most people with healthy teeth and gums are suitable candidates for teeth whitening.

sections.heading: How Long Do the Results Last?
sections.content: Results may last from one to several years depending on lifestyle habits.

sections.heading: How Can You Maintain the Results?
sections.content: Avoiding tobacco, coffee, and strongly colored beverages helps prolong the whitening effect.

faq.question: Does Teeth Whitening Damage Teeth?
faq.answer: Professional teeth whitening performed under the supervision of a dentist is considered safe.

faq.question: How Many Shades Can Teeth Become Whiter?
faq.answer: Results depend on the initial tooth color and individual patient characteristics.

blogIzbeljivanje.conclusion: Professional teeth whitening is a fast and effective way to enhance the appearance of your smile.

ortodoncija.excerpt: Properly aligned teeth make oral hygiene easier and reduce the risk of tooth decay and gum disease.

izbeljivanje.title: What Is Professional Teeth Whitening?
izbeljivanje.excerpt: A procedure that uses specialized gels and modern techniques to remove stains and discoloration from the tooth surface.

section1.title: A Healthy Smile Starts with Basic Care
section1.paragraph1: General dentistry includes diagnosis, treatment and prevention of dental diseases.
section1.paragraph2: Regular checkups and professional cleaning help prevent serious issues.
section1.paragraph3: We use digital X-rays for precise diagnosis and treatment planning.
